items.notes: invitedOrgId NULL is safe: the only writer (createSeller's post-invite updateSeller) sets invitationId, invitationStatus and invitedOrgId in ONE update, and migration 0026 added all three nullable together, so a NULL invitedOrgId with a non-null invitationId is unreachable through product code; such a row falls to 409 seller_not_invited before the Hub. Even a hand-made row would only let the Hub decide, scoped by the actor's own bearer token. sellers is a cross-org table (no org_id/RLS, listed by GET / to every admin), so 409 vs 404 for a never-invited seller leaks nothing new.
